senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חֵן)gratuitous act, favor, mostly adv. בח׳, לח׳, על ח׳ gratuitously; for no reason.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41:7">Ex. R. s. 41</cite> <he>על ח׳ בראתני וכ׳</he> hast thou created me for no purpose?—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="G00691"><he>זַרְזִיר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 28:1">Ex. R. s. 28</cite>, beg. <he>נטלה ח׳</he> he took it gratuitously.
Num. R. s. 1 מה אלו ח׳ וכ׳ as these things (fire, water &c.) are free to all &c.—מַתְּנַת ח׳ an undeserved gift.
Num. R. s. 11; a. fr.—שִׂנְאַת ח׳ gratuitous hatred, hostility without cause.
